fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential in-memory downloading and compiling of applets using curl and osacompile as seen used by XCSSET malware
fields.name: Potential In-Memory Download And Compile Of Payloads
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "osacompile" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "curl"))
